name: Landsknecht
description:
You crest the ridge and see the enemy's forces arrayed before you. Your gaze moves over them cooly: the left vanguard is slightly forward out of position, the right flank looks to be lagging behind a bit, and all but a few of them seem to be wearing armor of inferior quality. This should be an easy paycheck to earn. The wind tosses your glorious hair and catches the ruff of your collar. Brightly-colored cloth gathered from foreign lands billows luxuriantly through the gaps in your well-polished armor. You raise your weapon as the troops of your employer come over the ridge behind you. You look great. You feel great. You lead the charge down the slope with a fierce grin on your face and execute a practiced, gratuitous, leaping spin just before you plunge your blade into the front line of the enemy. Whichever army comes out on top today, everyone will remember you.

A Landsknecht is an unmatched offensive force on the battlefield. They bring expertise, skill and - above all - style to the fight. Their prowess in martial combat is exceptional, but you pay for what you get, and they come with the quirks of celebrity.

The Landsknecht mestiere uses, well, money - Treasure, that is - as a resource. The more the party spends on you, the more effective you are in combat. The Swagger ability governs this, granting per-Quest benefits and levels of Swagger, which amplify your abilities, grant benefits to your allies and allow you to bring additional engagement dice to each fight. You also have access to highly specialized polearms and firearms, which represent a frontier in martial technology and which no one else in the game has access to. Finally, your well-moneyed-but-deadly lifestyle has cultivated a Strange Fixation: a fear of a particular type of harmless object which troubles your otherwise charmed existence.

Landsknecht marries fashion and flair with combat superiority, for a price, with a touch of the strange.

Play a Landsknecht if you want to:

  • Have your power scale with your paycheck, feeding your exacting sartorial tastes in order to boost your confidence and abilities on the battlefield.

  • Fight with flair and a veteran's eye, combining presence and experience with shrewd tactics when the moment calls for it.

  • Be a complicated professional—loyal to the job and to those who have earned your respect (or paid your fee), with one private irrationality that cuts through all that composure.

Questions to consider when making a Landsknecht:

  • What conflicts have they fought in, and for whom? Do they have allegiances that outlasted the contract, or have they made a practice of leaving those behind?

  • What is the harmless object they cannot stand? How did that fixation begin, and how to they react when they encounter one?

  • How do they feel about the people who hire them? Respectful, contemptuous, fond, professionally detached? Has a past employer made an impression on them?

  • What does their kit look like? Where did the pieces come from? Which of them favor form over function?

  • Is there something they won't do for money? If so, have they ever been offered enough to test that conviction?

novizio.description: You have a wide range of experience in hand-to-hand combat. You have worked as a mercenary fighter long enough to garner a name for yourself and your reputation warrants high fees. Your elevated status has allowed you to grow a bit strange.
novizio.engagementDiceNotes: You get a variable set of engagement dice from your Swagger ability.
novizio.baseMpNotes: You increase your base MP through your Aura of Experience ability.
novizio.abilities: Swagger, Aura of Experience, Everyone Has A Price, Strange Fixation, and one other ability costing no more than 5 XP.
novizio.gratuiti: Fine undergarments. A variety of trinkets and accessories you've accumulated from around the world. A spyglass, cross-staff or gunner's rule. A lockbox or coinpurse.
